مقدمة
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. وجدي رشدي حبيب، تم اختباره بواسطة المهندس. 
سامي شحاتة، قبول م. Hany Fahmy Madny; 
general manager, 
approved by eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic 
Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC quality control 
general director, and MPIS Coordinator.
